contract.description: Report store health: active, superseded and tombstoned counts, active records per scope, pendingCompaction (journal entries clustered and waiting to be distilled into facts), idempotencyConflicts (active duplicates whose supersede maintenance never finished; 0 is healthy, replaying the same write converges them), and gc (the host-side sweep heartbeat: lastAttemptAt, lastSuccessAt, what the last sweep removed, lastError of the failed attempt; stale=true once the last success is older than two sweep intervals or the heartbeat is unreadable, meaning expired records may be piling up). Counts span the whole store; byTome splits active and tombstoned per tome and tome names the one your tools resolve to. Call it to check the store is reachable after a failed memory call, to size the compaction backlog before running memory_compact_candidates, or when the human asks what memory currently holds. upstream_unavailable here means the store itself is unreachable - no counts could be read.
